noncomputable def sumLexLift {α₁ : Type u_1} {α₂ : Type u_2} {β₁ : Type u_3} {β₂ : Type u_4} {γ₁ : Type u_5} {γ₂ : Type u_6}
  (f₁ : α₁ → β₁ → Finset γ₁) (f₂ : α₂ → β₂ → Finset γ₂)
  (g₁ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₁) (g₂ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₂)
  (a : α₁ ⊕ α₂) (b : β₁ ⊕ β₂) : Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) :=
match a, b with
| Sum.inl a₁, Sum.inl b₁ => f₁ a₁ b₁.map Sum.inl
| Sum.inr _, Sum.inl _ => ∅
| Sum.inl a₁, Sum.inr b₂ => Finset.union (g₁ a₁ b₂.map Sum.inl) (g₂ a₁ b₂.map Sum.inr)
| Sum.inr a₂, Sum.inr b₂ => f₂ a₂ b₂.map Sum.inr
end
